content.title: Navigate homepage search and results refinement controls by keyboard
content.intent: Prove the homepage search fields and CTA are reachable in order by Tab and the results-page Filters and Map controls are keyboard-accessible with visible focus indication.
content.technique_notes: Reused existing scenario coverage instead of minting a narrower duplicate because a fresh keyboard-accessibility scenario already covers the required results-page controls, even though it also spans homepage focus order. Techniques: a11y for keyboard reachability and visible focus state; state_flow because the path spans homepage routing into results-page refinement. Risk-judged interaction strength = 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss promise applies. No budget ceiling was set, so this path was kept.
